cards.title: The Fool
cards.description: Fresh beginnings, open roads, and trust before proof.
cards.upright: Say yes to the new path. Learn as you go, and keep your heart open.
cards.reversed: Risk without a plan can backfire. Slow down and check what you’re ignoring.
cards.prompt: Where are you being called to begin, even if you’re not “ready”?

cards.title: The Magician
cards.description: Focused will, skillful action, and turning ideas into reality.
cards.upright: You have what you need—use it with intention. Take the first concrete step.
cards.reversed: Scattered effort or manipulation. Get clear on motives and simplify your approach.
cards.prompt: What tool or talent are you underusing right now?

cards.title: The High Priestess
cards.description: Quiet knowing, intuition, and what’s sensed but not said.
cards.upright: Trust your instincts and listen more than you speak. Let answers unfold.
cards.reversed: You may be ignoring your gut. Make space for stillness and honesty.
cards.prompt: What do you already know, even if you don’t have “evidence”?

cards.title: The Empress
cards.description: Nurturing abundance, creativity, and growth that feels alive.
cards.upright: Tend what you love—relationships, projects, and your body. Growth follows care.
cards.reversed: Overgiving or neglecting yourself. Rebalance support and boundaries.
cards.prompt: Where do you need more care: home, body, or heart?

cards.title: The Emperor
cards.description: Structure, leadership, and stability built with clear boundaries.
cards.upright: Create a plan and follow it. Take responsibility and lead with clarity.
cards.reversed: Control is tightening too far. Loosen rigidity and invite collaboration.
cards.prompt: What boundary would make your life easier if you enforced it?

cards.title: The Hierophant
cards.description: Tradition, teaching, and the wisdom of proven systems.
cards.upright: Seek mentorship or trusted methods. Commit to practice, not shortcuts.
cards.reversed: Question the rules and update what no longer fits. Make your own path.
cards.prompt: Which “rule” do you follow out of habit rather than choice?

cards.title: The Lovers
cards.description: Choice, connection, and alignment between heart and values.
cards.upright: Choose what matches your values. Healthy bonds require honesty and reciprocity.
cards.reversed: Misalignment or temptation. Clarify what you want and what you’ll tolerate.
cards.prompt: What choice becomes obvious if you prioritize your values?

cards.title: The Chariot
cards.description: Determination, forward motion, and winning the inner tug-of-war.
cards.upright: Commit and move. Direction plus willpower gets results fast.
cards.reversed: You may be pushing without steering. Slow down and recalibrate your goal.
cards.prompt: Where are you forcing progress instead of directing it?

cards.title: Strength
cards.description: Quiet courage, compassionate control, and power guided by heart.
cards.upright: Stay steady and kind. True strength is consistent, not loud.
cards.reversed: Doubt or reactivity is draining you. Regroup and rebuild confidence gently.
cards.prompt: Where can you respond softly instead of proving something?

cards.title: The Hermit
cards.description: Solitude with purpose and guidance found within.
cards.upright: Step back to reflect. Your clarity comes from quiet focus.
cards.reversed: Isolation may be turning unhelpful. Reconnect or ask for support.
cards.prompt: What truth appears when you stop distracting yourself?

cards.title: Wheel of Fortune
cards.description: The cycle turns—timing shifts, and the story moves with it.
cards.upright: Expect movement and shifting luck. Adapt quickly and ride momentum.
cards.reversed: Resistance creates setbacks. Focus on what you can control.
cards.prompt: What is clearly changing—even if you don’t love it?

cards.title: Justice
cards.description: Truth, accountability, and consequences that balance the scales.
cards.upright: Make the honest call. Take responsibility and choose what’s fair.
cards.reversed: Bias or avoidance is present. Correct course before it costs more.
cards.prompt: Where do you need to be brutally honest with yourself?

cards.title: The Hanged Man
cards.description: Pause, surrender, and seeing the situation from a new angle.
cards.upright: Stop pushing. A new perspective unlocks the next move.
cards.reversed: Stagnation or refusal to shift. Release what’s keeping you stuck.
cards.prompt: What changes if you stop trying to control the outcome?

cards.title: Death
cards.description: Endings with purpose—transformation and clean beginnings.
cards.upright: Let the old end. You’re making room for something better suited.
cards.reversed: Fear of change prolongs pain. Choose closure and move forward.
cards.prompt: What are you holding onto that already ended?

cards.title: Temperance
cards.description: Balance in motion—blending extremes into something workable.
cards.upright: Simplify and stabilize. Small adjustments create lasting alignment.
cards.reversed: Too much/too little energy. Reset your routines and restore balance.
cards.prompt: What habit needs “less intensity, more consistency”?

cards.title: The Devil
cards.description: Attachment, temptation, and the chains we can remove.
cards.upright: Notice what owns you—habits, fear, or power dynamics. Choose awareness.
cards.reversed: Release and reclaiming power. You’re ready to break a pattern.
cards.prompt: What would change if you stopped negotiating with your worst habit?

cards.title: The Tower
cards.description: Sudden truth—collapse that clears space for something real.
cards.upright: What’s unstable falls away. It’s painful, but it frees you.
cards.reversed: You may be delaying the inevitable. Address cracks before they widen.
cards.prompt: What truth are you already aware of but resisting?

cards.title: The Star
cards.description: Hope returns—gentle healing and renewed faith in your path.
cards.upright: Recovery is underway. Keep going, and nourish what restores you.
cards.reversed: Discouragement is heavy. Start small—one supportive action is enough.
cards.prompt: What helps you feel hopeful even 5% more?

cards.title: The Moon
cards.description: Uncertainty, intuition, and navigating what isn’t fully clear yet.
cards.upright: Trust your instincts, but verify the story. Not everything is what it seems.
cards.reversed: Confusion is clearing. Name the fear and let the truth surface.
cards.prompt: What are you assuming without checking?

cards.title: The Sun
cards.description: Joy made visible—clarity, warmth, and confidence in full bloom.
cards.upright: Celebrate progress. Your energy is returning and things are aligning.
cards.reversed: A temporary cloud. Focus on what’s working and rebuild optimism.
cards.prompt: What win are you refusing to count?

cards.title: Judgement
cards.description: A wake-up call—reckoning, forgiveness, and choosing your next life.
cards.upright: This is your moment to rise. Learn from the past and answer the call.
cards.reversed: Fear of judgment keeps you stuck. Offer yourself grace and move.
cards.prompt: What decision would you make if you forgave yourself?

cards.title: The World
cards.description: Completion and integration—the story closes, and you step into the next.
cards.upright: A cycle completes. Enjoy the milestone and carry the lesson forward.
cards.reversed: Loose ends remain. Finish the last 10% with care.
cards.prompt: What needs closure before you can truly move on?

cards.title: Ace of Wands
cards.description: A spark ignites—new passion, new ideas, new momentum.
cards.upright: A fresh burst of motivation is here. Start now and learn by doing.
cards.reversed: Low energy or doubt is blocking you. Reconnect with what excites you.
cards.prompt: What idea keeps returning that you haven’t acted on yet?

cards.title: Two of Wands
cards.description: Vision on the horizon—planning the leap before you take it.
cards.upright: Decide where you’re going and commit. Your future needs a plan.
cards.reversed: Fear or indecision is shrinking your world. Pick one next step.
cards.prompt: What decision becomes easier if you stop waiting for certainty?

cards.title: Three of Wands
cards.description: Momentum builds—your effort begins to travel farther than you can see.
cards.upright: Keep going—results are forming. Stay open to wider opportunities.
cards.reversed: Delays require adjustment. Update the plan and keep moving.
cards.prompt: What’s one small adjustment that could unlock momentum?

cards.title: Four of Wands
cards.description: A milestone worth celebrating—homecoming, joy, and shared wins.
cards.upright: Pause to celebrate progress. Supportive people and environments strengthen you.
cards.reversed: Tension at home or lack of support. Create your own sense of safety.
cards.prompt: What would it look like to actually celebrate your progress?

cards.title: Five of Wands
cards.description: Creative friction—competition, conflict, and learning to work together.
cards.upright: Expect differing opinions. Use the heat to sharpen your work, not burn bridges.
cards.reversed: Avoiding conflict or stuck in it. Choose clarity, cooperation, or a clean exit.
cards.prompt: What conflict would improve if you named the real issue?

cards.title: Six of Wands
cards.description: Recognition arrives—effort seen, progress celebrated.
cards.upright: Take the win and keep showing up. Your work is landing.
cards.reversed: Feeling overlooked. Track real progress and don’t outsource your worth.
cards.prompt: Where do you crave approval—and what would self-validation look like?

cards.title: Seven of Wands
cards.description: Hold your ground—your boundaries protect what you’ve built.
cards.upright: Stand by your values. Protect your time and your work.
cards.reversed: Overwhelm is rising. Ask for support and tighten priorities.
cards.prompt: What boundary would lower your stress immediately?

cards.title: Eight of Wands
cards.description: Fast movement—messages, momentum, and things taking off.
cards.upright: Things are moving quickly. Respond, prioritize, and ride the momentum.
cards.reversed: Delays or scattered energy. Slow down and focus on the true target.
cards.prompt: What needs your immediate attention—and what can wait?

cards.title: Nine of Wands
cards.description: Resilience—tired but standing, wiser for what you’ve survived.
cards.upright: You’re close to the finish. Rest, reinforce boundaries, and keep going.
cards.reversed: Burnout or distrust is high. Heal your nervous system and ask for help.
cards.prompt: What would help you feel protected without shutting down?

cards.title: Ten of Wands
cards.description: Too much to carry—success becomes heavy when you do it alone.
cards.upright: Delegate and simplify. You don’t have to prove you can do it all.
cards.reversed: Let it go. Release obligations that aren’t aligned or necessary.
cards.prompt: What can you drop without the world ending?

cards.title: Page of Wands
cards.description: Curious beginnings—enthusiasm, exploration, and bold first steps.
cards.upright: Follow the spark. Try, experiment, and stay open to learning.
cards.reversed: Fear of failure or scattered focus. Commit to one small action.
cards.prompt: What would you try if you weren’t worried about being good at it?

cards.title: Knight of Wands
cards.description: Bold pursuit—passion in motion and risk taken on purpose.
cards.upright: Go for it with courage. Just make sure your plan can support your speed.
cards.reversed: Recklessness or burnout. Slow down and stop chasing novelty.
cards.prompt: Where are you confusing urgency with importance?

cards.title: Queen of Wands
cards.description: Magnetic confidence—warm leadership and creative fire.
cards.upright: Lead with warmth and boldness. Your presence gives others permission to shine.
cards.reversed: Insecurity or jealousy. Refocus on your lane and rebuild self-trust.
cards.prompt: What would you do today if you felt 20% braver?

cards.title: King of Wands
cards.description: Vision with authority—creative leadership and confident direction.
cards.upright: Step into leadership. Direct your energy toward a clear outcome.
cards.reversed: Ego or impatience may be steering. Reconnect to purpose and integrity.
cards.prompt: What would a strong, values-led leader do in your situation?

cards.title: Ace of Cups
cards.description: A new well of feeling—love, openness, and emotional renewal.
cards.upright: Open your heart. A fresh emotional beginning is available—receive it.
cards.reversed: Blocked feelings or emotional overwhelm. Make space to process gently.
cards.prompt: What emotion are you ready to feel fully instead of avoiding?

cards.title: Two of Cups
cards.description: Mutual care, honest connection, and the courage to meet in the middle.
cards.upright: A healthy bond forms through reciprocity. Keep it honest and steady.
cards.reversed: Imbalance or tension. Name needs and check alignment.
cards.prompt: What does “mutual” look like in your relationships?

cards.title: Three of Cups
cards.description: Joy shared—friendship, support, and community that lifts you.
cards.upright: Connect and celebrate. Let your people refill you.
cards.reversed: Drama or burnout. Protect your peace and choose your circle wisely.
cards.prompt: Who makes you feel safe to be fully yourself?

cards.title: Four of Cups
cards.description: Apathy or pause—emotions need honesty before they can move.
cards.upright: You may be emotionally checked out. Look again—an option is being offered.
cards.reversed: Re-engagement and new interest. Say yes to what genuinely nourishes you.
cards.prompt: What opportunity are you dismissing because you’re tired?

cards.title: Five of Cups
cards.description: Grief and regret—mourning what was while life still waits ahead.
cards.upright: Let yourself grieve. Then turn toward what remains and what can still be built.
cards.reversed: Healing and forgiveness are possible. Release shame and begin again.
cards.prompt: What would it look like to let the past be the past?

cards.title: Six of Cups
cards.description: Sweet memory—nostalgia, kindness, and soft healing.
cards.upright: Revisit what’s pure and supportive. Let tenderness guide your next step.
cards.reversed: Don’t get trapped in the past. Keep the lesson, release the fantasy.
cards.prompt: What memory is comforting you—and what does it ask you to do now?

cards.title: Seven of Cups
cards.description: Too many options—dreams, distractions, and the need for clarity.
cards.upright: Many paths are possible. Choose intentionally instead of drifting.
cards.reversed: Clarity returns. Commit to one option and ground it in reality.
cards.prompt: What choice becomes obvious if you stop chasing the “perfect” option?

cards.title: Eight of Cups
cards.description: Walking away—choosing growth over comfort and closing a chapter.
cards.upright: Leave what no longer fulfills you. Your next chapter requires courage.
cards.reversed: Fear of change keeps you stuck. Be honest about what isn’t working.
cards.prompt: What are you staying in out of habit rather than alignment?

cards.title: Nine of Cups
cards.description: Contentment—wishes, pleasure, and emotional satisfaction.
cards.upright: Enjoy what you’ve earned. Let yourself receive and savor the moment.
cards.reversed: Hedonism or emptiness. Check if you’re chasing comfort over meaning.
cards.prompt: What do you truly want—and what would “enough” feel like?

cards.title: Ten of Cups
cards.description: Emotional fulfillment—belonging, harmony, and love that feels safe.
cards.upright: This is a heart-level yes. Invest in what supports connection and stability.
cards.reversed: Misalignment at home or in values. Repair requires honesty and boundaries.
cards.prompt: What does a peaceful life actually require from you?

cards.title: Page of Cups
cards.description: A tender message—new feelings, intuition, and creative openness.
cards.upright: Stay curious and open-hearted. A new emotional or creative spark is emerging.
cards.reversed: Emotional insecurity or avoidance. Be gentle, but be honest about your feelings.
cards.prompt: What feeling wants your attention without judgment?

cards.title: Knight of Cups
cards.description: A romantic quest—moving with heart, imagination, and intention.
cards.upright: Follow your heart, and offer sincerity. Let emotion guide—but keep your feet on the ground.
cards.reversed: Moodiness or fantasy over reality. Check whether you’re avoiding practical truths.
cards.prompt: What would a grounded, honest version of your dream look like?

cards.title: Queen of Cups
cards.description: Deep compassion—emotional wisdom and intuitive care.
cards.upright: Lead with empathy and boundaries. Your sensitivity is a strength when protected.
cards.reversed: Overgiving or emotional overwhelm. Refill your cup before you pour.
cards.prompt: What boundary would protect your tenderness right now?

cards.title: King of Cups
cards.description: Emotional maturity—steady leadership with a calm heart.
cards.upright: Stay calm and compassionate. You can hold emotion without being ruled by it.
cards.reversed: Suppressed feelings or volatility. Practice honest expression and regulation.
cards.prompt: Where do you need to respond with calm instead of reacting?

cards.title: Ace of Swords
cards.description: A clean breakthrough—truth, clarity, and a decisive new idea.
cards.upright: A sharp insight cuts through confusion. Speak the truth and begin.
cards.reversed: Mental fog or miscommunication. Slow down and confirm facts.
cards.prompt: What truth is trying to come through clearly right now?

cards.title: Two of Swords
cards.description: A blocked choice—silence, stalemate, and avoiding the truth.
cards.upright: You’re delaying a decision. Gather facts, then choose.
cards.reversed: The truth breaks through. Stop avoiding and take action.
cards.prompt: What decision are you postponing because it feels uncomfortable?

cards.title: Three of Swords
cards.description: Heartbreak and clarity—painful truth that can still heal.
cards.upright: Let yourself feel and name the truth. Healing starts with honesty.
cards.reversed: Recovery is underway. Forgiveness and processing soften the edge.
cards.prompt: What truth are you finally ready to admit?

cards.title: Four of Swords
cards.description: Rest and recovery—your mind needs quiet to reset.
cards.upright: Take a break and restore your energy. Clarity returns after rest.
cards.reversed: Burnout or restless anxiety. You need real recovery, not just distraction.
cards.prompt: What would genuine rest look like in the next 24 hours?

cards.title: Five of Swords
cards.description: Conflict that costs—winning the argument, losing the peace.
cards.upright: Choose your battles. A win isn’t worth it if it burns bridges.
cards.reversed: De-escalation and repair. Make amends or walk away cleanly.
cards.prompt: Where are you trying to win instead of trying to resolve?

cards.title: Six of Swords
cards.description: Leaving rough waters—transition, relief, and moving on.
cards.upright: You’re heading toward calmer ground. Keep moving, even slowly.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change. Let the old chapter close so healing can begin.
cards.prompt: What are you afraid you’ll lose if you move on?

cards.title: Seven of Swords
cards.description: Strategy and secrecy—what’s hidden, and why.
cards.upright: Move carefully and think long-term. Check whether avoidance is the real driver.
cards.reversed: Truth comes out. It’s time to come clean or face what you’ve ignored.
cards.prompt: What are you not saying—and what is it costing you?

cards.title: Eight of Swords
cards.description: Feeling trapped—fear, self-doubt, and the illusion of no options.
cards.upright: You have more options than you think. Challenge the story that you’re powerless.
cards.reversed: Release and new agency. Take one step to prove you’re not stuck.
cards.prompt: What belief is keeping you smaller than you need to be?

cards.title: Nine of Swords
cards.description: Anxiety spirals—worry, guilt, and sleepless nights.
cards.upright: Your mind is catastrophizing. Ask for support and separate fear from fact.
cards.reversed: Relief is possible. Replace shame with compassion and take practical steps.
cards.prompt: What worry gets smaller when you say it out loud?

cards.title: Ten of Swords
cards.description: An ending that’s final—painful, but it stops the bleeding.
cards.upright: It’s done. Let it end so recovery can start.
cards.reversed: The worst is passing. Healing begins when you stop reopening the wound.
cards.prompt: What would change if you stopped trying to resurrect what ended?

cards.title: Page of Swords
cards.description: Curious mind—questions, vigilance, and learning through observation.
cards.upright: Ask questions and stay sharp. Gather information before you commit.
cards.reversed: Gossip or scattered thinking. Verify sources and slow your assumptions.
cards.prompt: What do you need to learn before you make your next move?

cards.title: Knight of Swords
cards.description: Direct action—fast decisions and speaking without hesitation.
cards.upright: Move decisively and speak clearly. Just make sure your facts are solid.
cards.reversed: Impulsiveness or harsh words. Slow down and consider impact.
cards.prompt: Where would slowing down improve your outcome?

cards.title: Queen of Swords
cards.description: Clear sight and clean boundaries—truth without cruelty.
cards.upright: Speak plainly and choose what’s true. Protect your time and energy.
cards.reversed: Coldness or harsh judgment. Soften the delivery without losing the truth.
cards.prompt: Where do you need to be direct, even if it’s awkward?

cards.title: King of Swords
cards.description: Ethical authority—clear thinking and fair decisions.
cards.upright: Lead with reason and principles. Make the fair call and communicate clearly.
cards.reversed: Rigid thinking or misuse of power. Reconnect to ethics and empathy.
cards.prompt: What would a fair-minded decision look like here?

cards.title: Ace of Pentacles
cards.description: A tangible start—new resources, opportunity, and steady growth.
cards.upright: A practical opportunity is here. Start small and build steadily.
cards.reversed: Missed chance or poor planning. Reassess resources and timing.
cards.prompt: What small step would make this opportunity real?

cards.title: Two of Pentacles
cards.description: Juggling it all—balance, flexibility, and time management.
cards.upright: You can handle it—stay flexible and keep your schedule realistic.
cards.reversed: Overcommitment. Simplify and stop pretending everything is equal priority.
cards.prompt: What’s one thing you can pause or delegate this week?

cards.title: Three of Pentacles
cards.description: Craft and collaboration—building something real with others.
cards.upright: Work well with others and value expertise. Shared effort creates better outcomes.
cards.reversed: Miscommunication or low standards. Clarify roles and raise quality.
cards.prompt: What would improve if everyone knew exactly what “done” means?

cards.title: Four of Pentacles
cards.description: Holding tight—security, control, and fear of loss.
cards.upright: Protect what matters, but don’t suffocate it. Balance saving with living.
cards.reversed: Loosening grip. Release scarcity thinking and allow flow.
cards.prompt: Where are you holding on too tightly—and what are you afraid will happen?

cards.title: Five of Pentacles
cards.description: Hard times—scarcity, isolation, and asking for help.
cards.upright: Help is available, but you must reach for it. You’re not meant to struggle alone.
cards.reversed: Recovery and support. Accept assistance and rebuild step by step.
cards.prompt: Where could you ask for help instead of white-knuckling it?

cards.title: Six of Pentacles
cards.description: Giving and receiving—support, fairness, and reciprocity.
cards.upright: Share resources wisely. Accept help without guilt and give without control.
cards.reversed: Strings attached or imbalance. Check motives and reset boundaries.
cards.prompt: Where do you give too much—or refuse help out of pride?

cards.title: Seven of Pentacles
cards.description: Patience and assessment—watching what you planted take root.
cards.upright: Keep tending your work. Results are coming, but they need time.
cards.reversed: Impatience or poor return. Adjust strategy or stop investing in the wrong place.
cards.prompt: What are you expecting too quickly—and what’s a realistic timeline?

cards.title: Eight of Pentacles
cards.description: Practice and mastery—small improvements that compound.
cards.upright: Focus on the work and refine your craft. Consistency creates excellence.
cards.reversed: Boredom or cutting corners. Recommit to quality and meaningful effort.
cards.prompt: What skill would change your life if you practiced it regularly?

cards.title: Nine of Pentacles
cards.description: Self-sufficiency—comfort earned and independence enjoyed.
cards.upright: Enjoy what you’ve built. Your discipline is paying off in real ways.
cards.reversed: Imposter feelings or dependence. Reclaim confidence in what you’ve earned.
cards.prompt: Where have you already succeeded but won’t let it count?

cards.title: Ten of Pentacles
cards.description: Legacy and stability—building something that outlasts you.
cards.upright: Long-term security and shared success. Think sustainable, not flashy.
cards.reversed: Instability or family tension around resources. Align values and plan responsibly.
cards.prompt: What do you want your long-term life to be built on?

cards.title: Page of Pentacles
cards.description: A practical beginning—learning, planning, and building skills.
cards.upright: Start the course, take the job, learn the skill. Consistency pays here.
cards.reversed: Procrastination or unrealistic plans. Choose one goal and make it actionable.
cards.prompt: What would you improve fast if you practiced it 10 minutes a day?

cards.title: Knight of Pentacles
cards.description: Steady progress—reliability, routine, and long-term effort.
cards.upright: Keep going—slow, steady effort wins. Build with patience and discipline.
cards.reversed: Stagnation or stubbornness. Adjust the routine and re-energize the plan.
cards.prompt: What small daily action would move you forward over time?

cards.title: Queen of Pentacles
cards.description: Grounded care—comfort, stability, and resourceful nurturing.
cards.upright: Create a supportive home base. Care for your body and manage resources wisely.
cards.reversed: Overgiving or controlling. Restore balance and prioritize your own needs.
cards.prompt: Where do you need to treat yourself like someone you’re responsible for?

cards.title: King of Pentacles
cards.description: Material mastery—security built through wisdom and integrity.
cards.upright: Lead responsibly and invest wisely. Build wealth and stability with patience.
cards.reversed: Greed or rigidity. Recenter on values and generosity.
cards.prompt: What does “success with integrity” look like for you?
